description: A hammerhead with a broad, evenly rounded head and no notch at the middle of its front edge, which gives it its name. It is dark olive to brownish grey above and white below, with a moderately tall, curved first dorsal fin. Unlike most hammerheads it favours temperate seas, and it eats fish, squid, rays and smaller sharks.
eats: Bony fish, squid, rays and smaller sharks
